policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O faces California lawsuit over safeguards after Hugging Face hack
items.summary: California AG alleges O misled and endangered the public by developing advanced models without necessary safeguards, citing the Hugging Face incident and broader transparency concerns.

items.headline: O funding reported at $11B with $1.25T valuation
items.summary: Bloomberg reports a portion of O’s funding close at $11B and $1.25T post-money valuation, building on prior disclosed commitments earlier in 2026.

items.headline: G private complaint says G LLC shifted to GroqCloud
items.summary: A G complaint filing notes a focus shift toward operating GroqCloud after an earlier Series A close, reflecting continuing go-to-market emphasis for inference services.
